what.text: This page follows refugees from Liberia living in Guinea, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 289 Liberian refugees in Guinea, 5.6% of all refugees from Liberia.
Côte d'Ivoire hosts the most Liberian refugees, followed by the United States, Ghana and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Liberia in 1989 and 1990, with the NPFL, and from 2000 to 2003, with LURD and MODEL.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1990 to 1997, begin in the first period.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 325000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 418210, at the end of 1995, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Guinea.
These are year-end totals for Guinea only, reported to UNHCR.
